option.enchantify.defaultX.tooltip: Skips the `X` button press required to start maxing out an item.
option.enchantify.hoverColor.tooltip: The color of needed enchantments that appear under the item.
option.enchantify.is_static.tooltip: Determines whether to enchantmax enchantments that are already applied.
option.enchantify.do_autofuse.tooltip: Determines whether to perform the Afterfuse Enchantment Modification Menu enhancement.
option.enchantify.anvil_apply_sound.tool: Determines whether to use the Anvil sound when clicking apply to your item.
option.enchantify.do_fancy_menu.tooltip: Determines whether to implement the fancy menu or the regular one.
option.enchantify.curse_order.tooltip: Determines the order of the curses in the menu.
